chunks: And (that is) what is dearest to you -- help from God and early victory. So give good tidings to those who believe.
ai.seo_question: What is the 'dearest thing' to the believers mentioned in Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the ultimate victory of the Ahl al-Bayt and the establishment of justice under Imam al-Mahdi (aj), framing 'Nasr' not merely as military success but as divine validation of the faithful's steadfastness. The term 'Fath Qarib' (near victory) is interpreted by scholars as both a temporal promise for the early community and an eschatological reality for the final triumph of truth over falsehood.
